_note: Sensitivity rates for the measures, NOT Ukrainian cost estimates (owner's review, 2026-10-19). Every rate carries its source and price year; the page shows cost ranges labelled as sensitivity. Replace with a priced bill of quantities when one exists.

embankment.unit_cost_source: Environment Agency, Cost estimation for fluvial defences (SC080039/R2, 2015): earth embankments £33 (>15 000 m³), £64 (5 000–15 000 m³), £94 (500–5 000 m³) per m³ of fill, UK prices; mid = the reviewer's illustrative 60 €/m³. Excludes revetment, seepage control, drainage, design and maintenance.

wall.unit_cost_source: Environment Agency SC080039/R2 (2015): flood walls 2.1–5.3 m high, £3 577 per linear metre, UK prices; converted at ~1.17 €/£.

benchmark_ua.source: Ivano-Frankivsk oblast flood-protection programme 2021–2025: 598.9 M UAH for 48 km of dike construction, reconstruction and restoration ≈ 12.48 M UAH/km (planned 2021 figures, mixed works, not new construction at 2026 prices) — owner's review 2026-10-19, to verify against the programme document.

ead.onset: the gauge's flood-plain level (flood_plain_cm − low water) where the yearbook gives one; below it the river stays in its channel and the levels do no damage
ead.curve: through the study's central 10 % / 1 % / 0.2 % rises, linear in the Gumbel reduced variate between them; below T = 10 extrapolated with the Gumbel slope of the study's Gumbel fit

cost_price.note: costs are brought to € of the Eurostat construction-cost price year (the same year as the eur_eurostat damage layer) with the Eurostat EU-27 index, so avoided EAD and cost are compared in one year and currency
cost_price.om_note: operation and maintenance of embankments as a share of capital cost per year — an assumption for the lifecycle view, not a Ukrainian norm

study.note: budget model for a detailed hydrodynamic study of one river reach (owner's review 2026-10-19): expert planning assumptions, 2026 prices, no VAT, not quotations; scaled by the modelled reach length (one reach may serve several hromadas)
study.survey_note: topography, bathymetry and field work for the reference reach; mountain reaches with bridges and narrow flood plains may exceed it

benchmarks.project: UNDP Tobago 2025 — geospatial flood-risk assessment and maps
UNDP Moldova 2025 — data collection for risk modelling and mapping
The Hills Shire (Australia) 2026 — hydraulic model adaptation, detailed maps
Puyallup River (USA) 2025 — HEC-RAS and FEMA mapping of 22.5 km

confidence_levels.1: HAND / DEM / statistical levels — preliminary screening
confidence_levels.2: HEC-RAS 1D/2D without validation — preliminary hydraulic assessment
confidence_levels.3: HEC-RAS 1D/2D with validation — detailed risk assessment
confidence_levels.4: validated model + uncertainty analysis + economic appraisal — basis for comparing protection options (still not engineering design)
